newsitem.title: USA: Comcast sets Internet access via cable.
newsitem.headline: Comcast sets Internet access via cable.

text.p: Comcast Corp on Wednesday unveiled Comcast(at)Home, a service that will allow people in the Baltimore area to use thier cable television lines to access the internet at speeds many times faster than via telephone lines.
The service will be provided in conjunction with (at)Home Network, a California based provider of high-speed interactive services. Terms of the deal were not disclosed.

Comcast, via its Comcast Cablevision of Maryland unit and Comcast Online Communications, will offer the service at $39.95 a month for its cable customers and $59.95 a month for non-cable customers for unlimited access to the Internet, they said.

Following the introduction of the service in Baltimore, Comcast will introduce the service in other areas including Sarasota, Florida, northern New Jersey and Orange County, California in the first half of 1997.
